sources.description: April 17, 2026 - Investors placed a bet worth about $760 million on a falling oil price around 20 minutes before Iran's foreign minister announced that the Strait of Hormuz was open. Oil prices fell up to 11% following the announcement.
sources.label: Reuters - Traders place $760 million bet on falling oil ahead of Hormuz announcement

sources.description: April 8, 2026 - Investors placed an approximately $950 million bet on oil prices falling just hours before the U.S. and Iran announced a ceasefire. Oil prices plunged 15% following the announcement.
sources.label: Reuters - Traders place large $950 million bet on oil price falling hours ahead of ceasefire

sources.description: April 15, 2026 - The CFTC is examining a series of trades in oil futures placed shortly before major shifts in Trump's Iran war policy, focusing on trading on CME Group and ICE platforms.
sources.label: Reuters - US probes suspicious oil trades made before Trump Iran pivots, source says

sources.description: March 2026 - Investigation into the March 23, 2026 trading surge where $500+ million in oil futures were sold 15 minutes before Trump announced delayed strikes. Trading volume was 9 times the average for that time of day.
sources.label: The New Yorker - Who Struck It Rich in the Markets When Trump Postponed Bombing Iran?

sources.description: September 22, 2025 - Investigation into how the DOJ's Public Integrity Section was gutted from 36 lawyers to 2 under the Trump administration, effectively ending its ability to investigate corrupt officials.
sources.label: NOTUS - The Justice Department Had 36 Lawyers Fighting Corruption Full-Time. Under Trump, It's Down to Two.

sources.description: April 2026 - Congressional letter calling for formal investigation into the March 22 oil futures trades, describing the activity as 'potentially the largest instance of insider trading in history.'
sources.label: Rep. Ritchie Torres - Letter Demanding SEC and CFTC Investigate Suspicious Oil Futures Trade

sources.description: April 10, 2025 - Trump posted 'GREAT TIME TO BUY!!! DJT' just hours before announcing a 90-day pause on tariffs. S&P 500 rose 9%, Nasdaq 12%, Trump Media stock jumped 22%.
sources.label: The Guardian - Trump ignites 'insider trading' accusations after global tariffs U-turn

sources.description: January 3, 2026 - A mysterious new user on Polymarket turned $35,000 into $400,000 betting on Maduro's capture hours before Trump announced it. Account was created December 27 and only bet on Venezuela intervention.
sources.label: The New Republic - Was Someone Insider Trading Right Before Trump's Attack on Venezuela?
